purpose: This repository's start profiles: how each of its test programs starts, so a session can boot one without composing `start`'s arguments by hand.

files.start/probe.json: `tests/guest/probe.conf`, the small program the tests against a real emulator run.
files.start/mouse.json: `tests/guest/mouse.conf` with `MOUSE.COM`, the program the input tests run.
files.start/bricks.json: `demos/bricks/bricks.conf`, the game of the bricks demo, which breaks at its own `int 3`.
files.start/mines.json: `demos/mines/mines.conf`, the VBE game of the mines demo.

notes: The screen maps this repository ships beside their demos stay there: a demo's map is part of what the demo shows.
`monkey` and `dpaint` have no start profile. Their conf is written per run from a template, and the game itself is not in this repository, so no profile could boot alone.

The test programs and the bricks demo are named through `DOSBOX_X_LIVE_GUEST_DIR` and `DOSBOX_X_LIVE_BRICKS_DIR`. A run of the tests against a real emulator copies them to a writable directory and points those variables at the copy.

The live test script exports both with this repository's own directories as their default, so a run from a clone reads the same profiles. A session that boots one outside those tests exports them too.
